meta.homeTitle: كُوب – Kub Coffee | Specialty coffee in Daraa
meta.homeDescription: Kub is a small café in Daraa: espresso, cappuccino, iced lattes and nut flavours, and a comfortable place to sit. See the menu and opening hours.
meta.menuDescription: The full Kub menu: hot and iced drinks and nut flavours, with prices in Syrian pounds.

demo.text: Demo version: prices, hours and contact details are samples; photos are from Unsplash

hero.heading: Specialty coffee, made slowly.
hero.body: A small café in Daraa where every cup is made with care, from a straight espresso to an iced latte.

intro.text: A good cup starts with the details: the right grind, a measured shot, milk steamed slowly. The rest is a good seat.

craft.heading: One cup at a time
craft.body: Espresso is the base of almost everything we serve. We make it in front of you, cup by cup, and set the milk the way you like it.

space.heading: Stay as long as you like
space.body: Come on your own with a book, or with friends after work. Order something hot or iced, and take your time.

nuts.heading: Add a flavour
nuts.body: Pistachio, hazelnut, pecan, almond, walnut or peanut, added to any drink, hot or iced.

menuPage.heading: Menu
menuPage.intro: Our hot and iced drinks, and the flavours you can add to any cup. Prices in Syrian pounds.
menuPage.ctaBody: Come and try it. We'll be here.

footer.tagline: Specialty coffee, made slowly, in Daraa.
